noteTecniche: Passo 1: Connect a standard handle to each arm of a cable machine, and position them in the most downward position. | Passo 2: Grab a Bosu Ball and position it in front and center of the cable machine. | Passo 3: Lie down on the Bosu Ball with the small of your back arched around the ball. Your hands should be at knee level. | Passo 6: Keep your arms straight and in-line with the upward angle of the cable. Elevate your torso in a crunching motion without dropping or bending your arms. | Passo 7: Maintain the rigid position with your arms.
